assessment: Operating observation deck at floor 48 of Torre Colpatria, Bogotá, with its own admission tickets and visitor hours. It is a standalone visit rather than a park attraction. Building opened in 1979 and is stated as 196 m tall by the operator.

observations.address: Carrera Séptima con Calle 26, Santa Fe, Bogotá
observations.hours: Operator: Thu/Fri 17:00–21:00 (last entry 20:20); Sat 12:00–21:00 (last entry 20:20); Sun/public holidays 11:00–18:00 (last entry 17:20). Normally Mon–Wed closed.
observations.pricingProvenance: Current individual ticket product pages checked 27 November 2026. The official ticket listing still displays older 25,000/30,000/23,000 COP amounts; individual product pages and their descriptions are used. Do not infer free admission below age four.
observations.weatherPolicy: Operator warns access may close for rain or operational reasons.

scopeNotes: Recurring hours are limited to 31 December 2026. Colombian public holidays on 8 and 25 December receive explicit holiday overrides; check 2027 hours when published.
The operator website had a July–August 2026 all-week special; it is expired and was not carried forward.
The product pages show nationality and age-specific admission; bring proof of eligibility. The older official listing amounts are recorded as a source discrepancy.
